text: Assumption: NetworkHandle has exclusive ownership semantics — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: NetworkHandle has exclusive ownership semantics — is this correct?
rationale: Copy constructor and copy assignment are explicitly deleted (delete), whereas move operations are provided ([SWS_ANM_01003], [SWS_ANM_01005]).
